# forgejo_team_repository (Resource)

Forgejo team repository resource. Grants a team access to a single repository of its organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

# Organization
resource "forgejo_organization" "owner" {
  name = "test_org"
}

# Team
resource "forgejo_team" "team" {
  organization_id = forgejo_organization.owner.id
  name            = "org_test_team"

  # A team that includes all repositories already has every repository of the
  # organization, so there would be nothing left to assign.
  includes_all_repositories = false

  units_map = {
    "repo.code" = "read"
  }
}

# Repository
resource "forgejo_repository" "repo" {
  owner = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  name  = "test_repo"
}

# Team repository
resource "forgejo_team_repository" "access" {
  team_id      = forgejo_team.team.id
  organization = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  repository   = forgejo_repository.repo.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization that owns the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `repository` (String) Name of the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the org_name/team_name/repo_name.
terraform import forgejo_team_repository.access test_org/org_test_team/test_repo
```
